nomologR: Guided scale development and construct validation

Source: R/utils-aaa.R
nomologR-package.Rd

nomologR coordinates established psychometric and structural-equation modeling tools while adding evidence-guided diagnostics, transparent decision logging, and teaching-oriented interpretation.

Details

The package follows a measurement-first philosophy: understand the item set and measurement model before interpreting a theory-specified structural network. Numerical reference values are prompts for investigation rather than universal deletion or validity rules.
